parsed_json.up: Identify the parent compound CHEMBL2403108 and all related salts using molecule_hierarchy parent mapping. Retrieve activity details for these compounds when they have IC50 bioactivity values in nM against target CHEMBL4247. Use the provenance path molecule_dictionary to compound_records to docs to activities to assays to target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
